title: Persevering Through Disability
definition: Persevering through disability means trusting and following Christ faithfully while living with physical, mental, or life limitations.
summary: Disability does not erase dignity, calling, usefulness, or purpose in Christ. God's strength is displayed in weakness.
christFocus: Christ gives purpose, grace, dignity, and hope to those living with weakness and limitation.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Disability does not erase dignity, calling, usefulness, or purpose in Christ. God's strength is displayed in weakness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
